text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race ended in a narrow defeat for both 
of them... However, neither of them had 
time to dwell on their regrets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Duramente setting her sights on the 
Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, Satono Crown 
vows to grow even stronger and face her 
once again someday...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overcome by an extraordinary fatigue, she 
collapsed. The culprit was an imbalance in 
her body, forcing her to spend the rest of 
the Classic year in rest and recovery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, you will retrain from the basics 
up—all so she can run medium-distance GⅠ 
races in peak condition. The next goal is 
the Senior Year Kyoto Kinen.
